name: University of Freiburg - University College Freiburg
summary: The University of Freiburg's English-taught college: one four-year Liberal Arts and Sciences bachelor, about 80 places a year, with four majors.

ib.text: Ranked on your IB converted to a German grade, a 500-word essay and a 500-word motivation letter. You need English at B2; the university must recognise your IB (KMK rule).

programmes.name: Liberal Arts and Sciences
programmes.ib: Majors: Culture and History, Governance, Life Sciences, or Environmental and Sustainability Sciences. Essay, motivation letter and an online orientation test are required.

notes: The 2027 dates are not out yet: for 2026 the window ran 1 June to 15 July, and UCF says it will amend its guidelines for 2027.
Freiburg's English B2 list names an IB only from an anglophone school, so ask UCF whether yours counts or take IELTS (5.5+) or TOEFL iBT (72+).
You register on hochschulstart first; if you apply elsewhere through it too, set your priorities by the DoSV cut-off (22 July in 2026).
